name: Vercel Drives
summary: Vercel Drives is persistent storage mounted as a directory inside a Vercel Sandbox. An agent's workspace or file-based memory lives on the drive, so a later sandbox can mount it and continue where the last run stopped. Drives can be forked for parallel workers or shared read-only through snapshots.
facts: 1 TiB default (1 GiB on Hobby), 16 TiB default max quota
Up to 4 drives per sandbox; one read-write mount at a time
Read-only point-in-time snapshots; writable forks that never merge back
One region per drive, iad1 by default
goodFor: Agent workspaces that outlive a sandbox
Forking a base workspace for parallel agents
watchOut: Only usable mounted in a Vercel Sandbox
Only paths under the mount persist; the rest of the sandbox is lost
Sandbox region must match the drive's region
